name: feature.commerce.buyer.nodes
description: UCP buyer node pack (MCP transport) — outbound agentic shopping against external UCP merchants over ctx.features.commerce: discover, search, build an AP2-mandated cart, checkout (ALWAYS human-approved + org-capped, fail-closed), track. A merchant is a REST base URL (merchantUrl) OR a reach:'mcp' connection (merchantServerId). The host is the payer; AP2 mandates are conformant eddsa-jcs-2022-signed when a key is configured (else an explicit not-VC-signed warning).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: UCP buyer: Discover merchant
nodes.description: Fetch an external merchant's UCP discovery document (egress-gated). Inputs: { merchantUrl | merchantServerId } (a REST base URL OR a reach:'mcp' connection id — ADR 0258; agent path uses a workspace credential). Output: { discovery }.

nodes.label: UCP buyer: Search catalog
nodes.description: Search an external merchant's catalog (read-only). Inputs: { merchantUrl | merchantServerId, q? } (REST or reach:'mcp' — ADR 0258). Output: { catalog }.

nodes.label: UCP buyer: Build cart
nodes.description: Author the AP2 Intent→Cart mandates for what the human authorized and persist a DRAFT purchase (no money moves). Inputs: { orgId, merchantUrl | merchantServerId, intent, maxAmountMinor (in the MINOR units of `currency` — the exponent varies: USD/EUR 2, JPY 0, so ¥50,000 is 50000 and NOT 5000000), currency, lines:[{externalProductId,name?,quantity,unitPriceMinor}] } (REST or reach:'mcp' — ADR 0258). Output: { purchase }.

nodes.label: UCP buyer: Checkout (gated)
nodes.description: Place the purchase — REAL-MONEY class: fails approval_required until a human signs off in the reviews inbox AND the org spend cap (OPENWOP_UCP_BUYER_ORG_CAP_MINOR, fail-closed) allows it. Idempotent: a placed purchase never re-posts. Inputs: { orgId, purchaseId }. Output: { purchase }.

nodes.label: UCP buyer: Track order
nodes.description: Read the external order's status (notifies on change). Inputs: { orgId, purchaseId }. Output: { purchase }.

nodes.label: UCP buyer: List purchases
nodes.description: List this org's buy-side purchases. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { purchases }.
